deck.note: Draw pile. 50 cards: 5 colors x (three 1s, two 2s, two 3s, two 4s, one 5). Server shuffles and deals.

hand.note: Inverted visibility: each player can see all OTHER players' hands but NOT their own. This is the defining feature of Hanabi.

discard_pile.note: Discarded cards. Visible to all players.

fireworks_red.note: Red firework stack. Cards played in ascending order 1-5.

fireworks_yellow.note: Yellow firework stack. Cards played in ascending order 1-5.

fireworks_green.note: Green firework stack. Cards played in ascending order 1-5.

fireworks_blue.note: Blue firework stack. Cards played in ascending order 1-5.

fireworks_white.note: White firework stack. Cards played in ascending order 1-5.

clue_tokens.note: Available clue tokens. Start at 8, max 8. Spend 1 to give a clue, regain 1 on discard.

fuse_tokens.note: Fuse tokens remaining. Start at 3. Lose 1 on failed play. Game over at 0.

card.note: Per color: three 1s, two 2s, two 3s, two 4s, one 5. Total 10 per color, 50 cards.

phases.name: deal
phases.note: Server shuffles deck and deals 5 cards to each player.

phases.name: play
phases.note: Each turn: give_clue, play_card, or discard_card. Exactly one action per turn.

give_clue.constraint: must point to ALL cards matching the attribute in target's hand
give_clue.effect: spend 1 clue token; indicate all cards of the given color OR number in target's hand
give_clue.note: Clue must match at least one card. Attribute is 'color' or 'number'. Points to every matching card.

play_card.effect: remove card from hand; if card is next in its color's firework sequence, place on stack; otherwise lose 1 fuse token and discard the card; draw replacement from deck if available
play_card.note: A card is playable if its number is exactly 1 more than the top of its color's firework stack (or 1 if stack is empty). Playing a 5 successfully regains 1 clue token (if below max).

discard_card.effect: remove card from hand to discard pile; regain 1 clue token (up to max 8); draw replacement from deck if available
discard_card.note: Cannot discard if clue tokens are already at maximum (8).

draw_replacement.effect: draw top card from deck into current player's hand
draw_replacement.note: When deck empties, each player gets one final turn.

library.all_fireworks_complete: fireworks_red.count == 5 AND fireworks_yellow.count == 5 AND fireworks_green.count == 5 AND fireworks_blue.count == 5 AND fireworks_white.count == 5
